description:
crate-jmap-sharing-server has an inline test get_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found (principal.rs:316) for Principal/get, and the dispatcher-level test registers_all_10_methods (lib.rs:419) does NOT pass an unknown accountId. There is no unit test or integration test that asserts Principal/set or ShareNotification/set with unknown accountId returns accountNotFound. As a direct consequence the missing-account_exists bug (bd:JMAP-3t94.1) shipped uncaught.

Scenario triggering the cost: a future contributor adds a new sibling extension server by cookie-cutting from this crate. They copy the /set handlers and inherit the missing check. Their test suite passes because they cookie-cut the test files too, none of which assert accountNotFound on /set.

Maintenance consequence: every new sibling repeats the bug. The test-coverage gap is the upstream cause of the propagation.

Fix: add two inline tests next to get_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found:
  - set_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found (Principal/set with create={} on unknown account)
  - share_notification_set_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found

Then propagate to the canonical jmap-mail-server (which has the check but no test) so future cookie-cuts include the test by default.
notes:
Added inline regression tests:
- src/principal.rs::tests::set_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found
- src/notification.rs::tests::set_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found
- src/memory.rs::tests::get_changes_recycled_id_lands_in_created (regression for .3)
- src/memory.rs::tests::get_changes_create_then_destroy_lands_in_destroyed_only (negative regression for .3)

The /set tests cover the gap identified in the original bead. The /changes tests document the workspace's choice among the RFC 8620 §5.2 MAY-allowed reportings (destroyed-only for create→destroy; created for create→destroy→create recycled).
title: No test coverage for unknown-account on /set handlers in sharing-server
